fullText.simplified:
后记：

    孙悟空从石头里出来的时候，只是一只普通的石猴。他第一个跳进瀑布，做上了花果山的大王。再后来，他想要长生不老，于是去了西洲跟着葡提老师学本事，学会了七十二变，终于有了强大的力量。但随着能力越来越强，他的心境发生了变化，强大的力量让他越来越骄傲。
    在打败魔王、拿走金箍棒、改写生死本之后，孙悟空觉得自己什么都能做，而且没有人能打败他了。这样的他，当然不能接受做个小小的毕马温，更不能接受别人看不起他。特别是后来天宫的神仙也打不过他，这让他更加骄傲了。在他心里，他和天一样高，他就是齐天大圣！
    但是，太过自信一定会给他带来麻烦。虽然孙悟空现在很强大，但他忘记了最重要的东西，那就是“修心”和“静心”，他早把葡提老师教给他的忘得干干净净。他认为自己是最厉害的，但世界上总有比他更强大的人。也许以后，当他遇到更厉害的人时，他才会明白，真正的强大不仅要有兵器和本事，更要懂得“修心”和“静心”。
    另外，从这个故事里，我们还认识了一个有意思的中国神话世界。
    这个世界有三界：天界、人间和阴间。天界是神仙的世界，人间是人的世界，阴间是人死后的世界。
    在人间，有皇帝，皇帝是人间的王；在阴间，有言王，他是阴间的王；在天界，有玉帝，他和许多神仙住在天宫。
    玉帝是三界最重要的神，他管理着三界。
    太白金星是天界很有名的神仙，不但大大小小的神仙认识他，而且四方的妖怪也都听说过他。他很聪明，非常受欢迎，是玉帝的重要手下。
    言王住在地府。“生死本”是地府最重要的东西，上面记着每个人的出生时间和死去时间。言王有两个重要的手下，黑无常和白无常。人们都听说过，人死后会见到他们两个，然后被他们带去阴间。因为他们的工作和“死”有关，所以人们不太喜欢他们。
    故事里还出现了四海龙王。他们都是神仙，住在海底的龙宫，管理着四海。
    太白金星、言王和龙王都要听玉帝的安排，玉帝管理着他们。
    他们都是中国神话世界里非常重要的神和角色。
fullText.traditional:
後記：

    孫悟空從石頭裡出來的時候，只是一隻普通的石猴。他第一個跳進瀑布，做上了花果山的大王。再後來，他想要長生不老，於是去了西洲跟著葡提老師學本事，學會了七十二變，終於有了強大的力量。但隨著能力越來越強，他的心境發生了變化，強大的力量讓他越來越驕傲。
    在打敗魔王、拿走金箍棒、改寫生死本之後，孫悟空覺得自己什麼都能做，而且沒有人能打敗他了。這樣的他，當然不能接受做個小小的畢馬溫，更不能接受別人看不起他。特別是後來天宮的神仙也打不過他，這讓他更加驕傲了。在他心裡，他和天一樣高，他就是齊天大聖！
    但是，太過自信一定會給他帶來麻煩。雖然孫悟空現在很強大，但他忘記了最重要的東西，那就是“修心”和“靜心”，他早把葡提老師教給他的忘得乾乾淨淨。他認為自己是最厲害的，但世界上總有比他更強大的人。也許以後，當他遇到更厲害的人時，他才會明白，真正的強大不僅要有兵器和本事，更要懂得“修心”和“靜心”。
    另外，從這個故事裡，我們還認識了一個有意思的中國神話世界。
    這個世界有三界：天界、人間和陰間。天界是神仙的世界，人間是人的世界，陰間是人死後的世界。
    在人間，有皇帝，皇帝是人間的王；在陰間，有言王，他是陰間的王；在天界，有玉帝，他和許多神仙住在天宮。
    玉帝是三界最重要的神，他管理著三界。
    太白金星是天界很有名的神仙，不但大大小小的神仙認識他，而且四方的妖怪也都聽說過他。他很聰明，非常受歡迎，是玉帝的重要手下。
    言王住在地府。“生死本”是地府最重要的東西，上面記著每個人的出生時間和死去時間。言王有兩個重要的手下，黑無常和白無常。人們都聽說過，人死後會見到他們兩個，然後被他們帶去陰間。因為他們的工作和“死”有關，所以人們不太喜歡他們。
    故事裡還出現了四海龍王。他們都是神仙，住在海底的龍宮，管理著四海。
    太白金星、言王和龍王都要聽玉帝的安排，玉帝管理著他們。
    他們都是中國神話世界裡非常重要的神和角色。

sentences.simplified: 孙悟空从石头里出来的时候，只是一只普通的石猴。
sentences.traditional: 孫悟空從石頭裡出來的時候，只是一隻普通的石猴。

sentences.english: When Sun Wukong emerged from the stone, he was just an ordinary stone monkey.

sentences.simplified: 他第一个跳进瀑布，做上了花果山的大王。
sentences.traditional: 他第一個跳進瀑布，做上了花果山的大王。
sentences.pinyin: tā dì yī ge tiào jìn pù bù zuò shàng le huā guǒ shān de dà wáng
sentences.english: He was the first to jump into the waterfall and became the Great King of Mount Huaguo.

sentences.simplified: 再后来，他想要长生不老，于是去了西洲跟着葡提老师学本事，
sentences.traditional: 再後來，他想要長生不老，於是去了西洲跟著葡提老師學本事，

sentences.english: Later, he wanted to live forever, so he went to the Western Continent and learned skills from Teacher Puti.

sentences.simplified: 学会了七十二变，终于有了强大的力量。
sentences.traditional: 學會了七十二變，終於有了強大的力量。
sentences.pinyin: xué huì le qī shí èr biàn zhōng yú yǒu le qiáng dà de lì liàng
sentences.english: He mastered the seventy-two transformations and finally gained great power.

sentences.simplified: 但随着能力越来越强，他的心境发生了变化，强大的力量让他越来越骄傲。
sentences.traditional: 但隨著能力越來越強，他的心境發生了變化，強大的力量讓他越來越驕傲。
sentences.pinyin: dàn suí zhe néng lì yuè lái yuè qiáng tā de xīn jìng fā shēng le biàn huà qiáng dà de lì liàng ràng tā yuè lái yuè jiāo ào
sentences.english: But as his abilities grew more powerful, his mindset changed, and his immense power made him increasingly arrogant.

sentences.simplified: 在打败魔王、拿走金箍棒、改写生死本之后，
sentences.traditional: 在打敗魔王、拿走金箍棒、改寫生死本之後，

sentences.english: After defeating the demon king, taking the Golden Cudgel, and rewriting the Book of Life and Death, ..

sentences.simplified: 孙悟空觉得自己什么都能做，而且没有人能打败他了。
sentences.traditional: 孫悟空覺得自己什麼都能做，而且沒有人能打敗他了。

sentences.english: .. Sun Wukong felt like he could do anything, and no one could defeat him.

sentences.simplified: 这样的他，当然不能接受做个小小的毕马温，
sentences.traditional: 這樣的他，當然不能接受做個小小的畢馬溫，
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng de tā dāng rán bù néng jiē shòu zuò ge xiǎo xiǎo de bì mǎ wēn
sentences.english: With such a mindset, he certainly could not come to terms with being a measly Protector of the Horses, ..

sentences.simplified: 更不能接受别人看不起他。
sentences.traditional: 更不能接受別人看不起他。
sentences.pinyin: gèng bù néng jiē shòu bié rén kàn bu qǐ tā
sentences.english: .. and even more so, he could not come to terms with being looked down upon by others.

sentences.simplified: 特别是后来天宫的神仙也打不过他，这让他更加骄傲了。
sentences.traditional: 特別是後來天宮的神仙也打不過他，這讓他更加驕傲了。
sentences.pinyin: tè bié shì hòu lái tiān gōng de shén xiān yě dǎ bú guò tā zhè ràng tā gèng jiā jiāo ào le
sentences.english: Especially later, when even the  immortals of the Heavenly Palace could not defeat him, it made him even more arrogant.

sentences.simplified: 在他心里，他和天一样高，他就是齐天大圣！
sentences.traditional: 在他心裡，他和天一樣高，他就是齊天大聖！
sentences.pinyin: zài tā xīn lǐ tā hé tiān yí yàng gāo tā jiù shì qí tiān dà shèng
sentences.english: In his heart, he stood as high as Heaven. He was the Great Sage Equal to Heaven!

sentences.simplified: 但是，太过自信一定会给他带来麻烦。
sentences.traditional: 但是，太過自信一定會給他帶來麻煩。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tài guò zì xìn yí dìng huì gěi tā dài lái má fan
sentences.english: However, being overly confident would certainly bring him trouble.

sentences.simplified: 虽然孙悟空现在很强大，
sentences.traditional: 雖然孫悟空現在很強大，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán sūn wù kōng xiàn zài hěn qiáng dà
sentences.english: Although Sun Wukong was very powerful now, ..

sentences.simplified: 但他忘记了最重要的东西，那就是“修心”和“静心”，
sentences.traditional: 但他忘記了最重要的東西，那就是“修心”和“靜心”，
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā wàng jì le zuì zhòng yào de dōng xi nà jiù shì xiū xīn hé jìng xīn
sentences.english: .. he had forgotten the most important things, which were “cultivating the mind” and “calming the mind”.

sentences.simplified: 他早把葡提老师教给他的忘得干干净净。
sentences.traditional: 他早把葡提老師教給他的忘得乾乾淨淨。
sentences.pinyin: tā zǎo bǎ pú tí lǎo shī jiāo gěi tā de wàng de gān gān jìng jìng
sentences.english: He had long completely forgotten everything that Teacher Puti taught him.

sentences.simplified: 他认为自己是最厉害的，但世界上总有比他更强大的人。
sentences.traditional: 他認為自己是最厲害的，但世界上總有比他更強大的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā rèn wéi zì jǐ shì zuì lì hai de dàn shì jiè shang zǒng yǒu bǐ tā gèng qiáng dà de rén
sentences.english: He believed he was the most powerful, but there will always be stronger people in this world.

sentences.simplified: 也许以后，当他遇到更厉害的人时，
sentences.traditional: 也許以後，當他遇到更厲害的人時，
sentences.pinyin: yě xǔ yǐ hòu dāng tā yù dào gèng lì hai de rén shí
sentences.english: Perhaps in the future, when he meets someone even more powerful, ..

sentences.simplified: 他才会明白，真正的强大不仅要有兵器和本事，
sentences.traditional: 他才會明白，真正的強大不僅要有兵器和本事，
sentences.pinyin: tā cái huì míng bai zhēn zhèng de qiáng dà bù jǐn yào yǒu bīng qì hé běn shi
sentences.english: .. he will understand then that true strength requires not only weapons and skill, ..

sentences.simplified: 更要懂得“修心”和“静心”。
sentences.traditional: 更要懂得“修心”和“靜心”。
sentences.pinyin: gèng yào dǒng de xiū xīn hé jìng xīn
sentences.english: .. but more so knowing how to “cultivate the mind” and “calm the mind”.

sentences.simplified: 另外，从这个故事里，我们还认识了一个有意思的中国神话世界。
sentences.traditional: 另外，從這個故事裡，我們還認識了一個有意思的中國神話世界。
sentences.pinyin: lìng wài cóng zhè ge gù shi lǐ wǒ men hái rèn shi le yí ge yǒu yì si de zhōng guó shén huà shì jiè
sentences.english: Additionally, from this story, we also got to know the fascinating world of Chinese mythology.

sentences.simplified: 这个世界有三界：天界、人间和阴间。
sentences.traditional: 這個世界有三界：天界、人間和陰間。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shì jiè yǒu sān jiè tiān jiè rén jiān hé yīn jiān
sentences.english: This world has Three Realms: the Heavenly Realm, the Human World, and the Netherworld.

sentences.simplified: 天界是神仙的世界，人间是人的世界，
sentences.traditional: 天界是神仙的世界，人間是人的世界，
sentences.pinyin: tiān jiè shì shén xiān de shì jiè rén jiān shì rén de shì jiè
sentences.english: The Heavenly Realm is the world of immortals, the Human Realm is the world of humans, ..

sentences.simplified: 阴间是人死后的世界。
sentences.traditional: 陰間是人死後的世界。
sentences.pinyin: yīn jiān shì rén sǐ hòu de shì jiè
sentences.english: .. and the Netherworld is the world of humans after death.

sentences.simplified: 在人间，有皇帝，皇帝是人间的王；
sentences.traditional: 在人間，有皇帝，皇帝是人間的王；
sentences.pinyin: zài rén jiān yǒu huáng dì huáng dì shì rén jiān de wáng
sentences.english: In the Human Realm, there is the emperor, who is the king of the Human Realm.

sentences.simplified: 在阴间，有言王，他是阴间的王；
sentences.traditional: 在陰間，有言王，他是陰間的王；
sentences.pinyin: zài yīn jiān yǒu yán wáng tā shì yīn jiān de wáng
sentences.english: In the Netherworld, there is Yan Wang, who is the king of the Netherworld.

sentences.simplified: 在天界，有玉帝，他和许多神仙住在天宫。
sentences.traditional: 在天界，有玉帝，他和許多神仙住在天宮。
sentences.pinyin: zài tiān jiè yǒu yù dì tā hé xǔ duō shén xiān zhù zài tiān gōng
sentences.english: In the Heavenly Realm, there is the Jade Emperor. He and many other immortals live in the Heavenly Palace.

sentences.simplified: 玉帝是三界最重要的神，他管理着三界。
sentences.traditional: 玉帝是三界最重要的神，他管理著三界。
sentences.pinyin: yù dì shì sān jiè zuì zhòng yào de shén tā guǎn lǐ zhe sān jiè
sentences.english: The Jade Emperor is the most important immortal across all three realms. He manages the three realms.

sentences.simplified: 太白金星是天界很有名的神仙，
sentences.traditional: 太白金星是天界很有名的神仙，
sentences.pinyin: tài bái jīn xīng shì tiān jiè hěn yǒu míng de shén xiān
sentences.english: Taibai Jinxing is a very famous immortal in the Heavenly Realm.

sentences.simplified: 不但大大小小的神仙认识他，而且四方的妖怪也都听说过他。
sentences.traditional: 不但大大小小的神仙認識他，而且四方的妖怪也都聽說過他。
sentences.pinyin: bú dàn dà dà xiǎo xiǎo de shén xiān rèn shi tā ér qiě sì fāng de yāo guài yě dōu tīng shuō guò tā
sentences.english: All the immortals, great and small, know him, and even the demons from all over have heard of his name.

sentences.simplified: 他很聪明，非常受欢迎，是玉帝的重要手下。
sentences.traditional: 他很聰明，非常受歡迎，是玉帝的重要手下。
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn cōng ming fēi cháng shòu huān yíng shì yù dì de zhòng yào shǒu xià
sentences.english: He is very clever, extremely popular, and an important subordinate of the Jade Emperor.

sentences.simplified: 言王住在地府。
sentences.traditional: 言王住在地府。
sentences.pinyin: yán wáng zhù zài dì fǔ
sentences.english: Yan Wang lives in the Underworld.

sentences.simplified: “生死本”是地府最重要的东西，
sentences.traditional: “生死本”是地府最重要的東西，
sentences.pinyin: shēng sǐ běn shì dì fǔ zuì zhòng yào de dōng xi
sentences.english: The “Book of Life and Death” is the most important thing in the Underworld.

sentences.simplified: 上面记着每个人的出生时间和死去时间。
sentences.traditional: 上面記著每個人的出生時間和死去時間。
sentences.pinyin: shàng miàn jì zhe měi ge rén de chū shēng shí jiān hé sǐ qù shí jiān
sentences.english: It records everyone’s time of birth and time of death.

sentences.simplified: 言王有两个重要的手下，黑无常和白无常。
sentences.traditional: 言王有兩個重要的手下，黑無常和白無常。
sentences.pinyin: yán wáng yǒu liǎng ge zhòng yào de shǒu xià hēi wú cháng hé bái wú cháng
sentences.english: Yan Wang has two important subordinates, Black Impermanence and White Impermanence.

sentences.simplified: 人们都听说过，人死后会见到他们两个，然后被他们带去阴间。
sentences.traditional: 人們都聽說過，人死後會見到他們兩個，然後被他們帶去陰間。

sentences.english: Everyone has heard that after death, they will meet these two and be taken to the Underworld by them.

sentences.simplified: 因为他们的工作和“死”有关，所以人们不太喜欢他们。
sentences.traditional: 因為他們的工作和“死”有關，所以人們不太喜歡他們。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā men de gōng zuò hé sǐ yǒu guān suǒ yǐ rén men bú tài xǐ huan tā men
sentences.english: Because their work is related to “death,” people don’t like them very much.

sentences.simplified: 故事里还出现了四海龙王。
sentences.traditional: 故事裡還出現了四海龍王。
sentences.pinyin: gù shi lǐ hái chū xiàn le sì hǎi lóng wáng
sentences.english: The Dragon Kings of the Four Seas also appear in this story.

sentences.traditional: 他們都是神仙，住在海底的龍宮，管理著四海。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dōu shì shén xiān zhù zài hǎi dǐ de lóng gōng guǎn lǐ zhe sì hǎi
sentences.english: They are all immortals who live in the Dragon Palaces under the sea and rule over the Four Seas.

sentences.simplified: 太白金星、言王和龙王都要听玉帝的安排，玉帝管理着他们。
sentences.traditional: 太白金星、言王和龍王都要聽玉帝的安排，玉帝管理著他們。
sentences.pinyin: tài bái jīn xīng yán wáng hé lóng wáng dōu yào tīng yù dì de ān pái yù dì guǎn lǐ zhe tā men
sentences.english: Taibai Jinxing, Yan Wang, and the Dragon Kings all follow the Jade Emperor’s orders, since the Jade Emperor rules over them.

sentences.simplified: 他们都是中国神话世界里非常重要的神和角色。
sentences.traditional: 他們都是中國神話世界裡非常重要的神和角色。

sentence_translations: Epilogue:
When Sun Wukong emerged from the stone, he was just an ordinary stone monkey.
He was the first to jump into the waterfall and became the Great King of Mount Huaguo.
Later, he wanted to live forever, so he went to the Western Continent and learned skills from Teacher Puti.
He mastered the seventy-two transformations and finally gained great power.
But as his abilities grew more powerful, his mindset changed, and his immense power made him increasingly arrogant.
After defeating the demon king, taking the Golden Cudgel, and rewriting the Book of Life and Death, ..
.. Sun Wukong felt like he could do anything, and no one could defeat him.
With such a mindset, he certainly could not come to terms with being a measly Protector of the Horses, ..
.. and even more so, he could not come to terms with being looked down upon by others.
Especially later, when even the  immortals of the Heavenly Palace could not defeat him, it made him even more arrogant.
In his heart, he stood as high as Heaven. He was the Great Sage Equal to Heaven!
However, being overly confident would certainly bring him trouble.
Although Sun Wukong was very powerful now, ..
.. he had forgotten the most important things, which were “cultivating the mind” and “calming the mind”.
He had long completely forgotten everything that Teacher Puti taught him.
He believed he was the most powerful, but there will always be stronger people in this world.
Perhaps in the future, when he meets someone even more powerful, ..
.. he will understand then that true strength requires not only weapons and skill, ..
.. but more so knowing how to “cultivate the mind” and “calm the mind”.
Additionally, from this story, we also got to know the fascinating world of Chinese mythology.
This world has Three Realms: the Heavenly Realm, the Human World, and the Netherworld.
The Heavenly Realm is the world of immortals, the Human Realm is the world of humans, ..
.. and the Netherworld is the world of humans after death.
In the Human Realm, there is the emperor, who is the king of the Human Realm.
In the Netherworld, there is Yan Wang, who is the king of the Netherworld.
In the Heavenly Realm, there is the Jade Emperor. He and many other immortals live in the Heavenly Palace.
The Jade Emperor is the most important immortal across all three realms. He manages the three realms.
Taibai Jinxing is a very famous immortal in the Heavenly Realm.
All the immortals, great and small, know him, and even the demons from all over have heard of his name.
He is very clever, extremely popular, and an important subordinate of the Jade Emperor.
Yan Wang lives in the Underworld.
The “Book of Life and Death” is the most important thing in the Underworld.
It records everyone’s time of birth and time of death.
Yan Wang has two important subordinates, Black Impermanence and White Impermanence.
Everyone has heard that after death, they will meet these two and be taken to the Underworld by them.
Because their work is related to “death,” people don’t like them very much.
The Dragon Kings of the Four Seas also appear in this story.
They are all immortals who live in the Dragon Palaces under the sea and rule over the Four Seas.
Taibai Jinxing, Yan Wang, and the Dragon Kings all follow the Jade Emperor’s orders, since the Jade Emperor rules over them.
They are all very important immortals and characters in the world of Chinese mythology.
